name: POST /admin/federation/iceberg-catalogs — api-gateway
description: Registers (or updates) a federation.iceberg_catalog row so the lineage-projector worker can resolve a target table_ref, giving ops an alternative to raw SQL and preserving the auto-migrate doctrine. Upsert semantics: ON CONFLICT (catalog_id) DO UPDATE overwrites region, backend, root_url, capacity_tier and status, so re-posting an existing catalog_id is an update and still returns 201, never 409. capacity_tier defaults to "standard" and status to "active". QA edge cases: backend is validated against the closed set glue|nessie|hive and anything else is a 400; catalog_id, region, backend and root_url are all required and empty strings count as missing; root_url is not URL-validated; status is NOT validated in the handler, so an out-of-enum status reaches the DB check constraint and returns 500 rather than 400. IDEMPOTENCY (MUST-47): federation.iceberg_catalog carries UNIQUE (region, backend). catalog_id was already {{dynamic:slug}} but that is the PRIMARY KEY, not the unique pair — so a second run re-sent region=us-east-1 + backend=nessie and died on federation_iceberg_catalog_region_backend_uq with a 500. backend is CHECK-constrained to glue|nessie|hive and cannot be randomised, so region carries the uniqueness instead. NAMESPACE WARNING: the catalog_id this returns identifies a LAKEHOUSE catalog in federation.iceberg_catalog and is meaningful only to the lineage projector and other federation routes. It is NOT a billing rate card: passing it to POST /api/billing/invoices/generate returns 404 CatalogNotFound, because that endpoint resolves catalog_id against meter.pricing_catalog, produced by POST /admin/meter/pricing-catalogs. The two share a field name and nothing else — consume this one via the cache key federation-iceberg-catalogs.create.response.data.catalog_id only.

errorCases.when: x-admin-ops-token header is missing, empty, or matches neither the env ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN break-glass secret (constant-time compare) nor the SHA-256 hash of any active row in admin.ops_token; revoked/expired DB tokens keep working until the per-replica cache expires (ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN_CACHE_TTL_MS, default 30s) unless a Redis invalidation broadcast lands first

errorCases.message: catalog_id, region, backend, root_url are required
errorCases.when: any of catalog_id, region, backend or root_url is missing, null, or an empty string

errorCases.message: backend must be one of: glue, nessie, hive
errorCases.when: backend is present but not one of glue, nessie, hive
the INSERT ... ON CONFLICT into federation.iceberg_catalog throws — e.g. status outside the allowed enum hitting a check constraint, or Postgres unavailable
